title: Orbit Survivors
description: A neon roguelite survival arena. Your core's orbs fight for you: drag to dodge the swarm, collect gems, level up and combine upgrades into game-breaking evolutions. Survive the bosses.
instructions: Drag anywhere (touch or mouse) to move. Orbs orbit and attack automatically. Tap with a second finger, double-tap or press Space to dash once unlocked. WASD/arrows also work. Pick 1 of 3 upgrades on every level up.
